remarks: Effortless Luxury Living at the Buckingham Condominium. You can have it all!! Move without compromise in this elegant and meticulously maintained 3-bedroom, 2-bath condo at the sought-after Buckingham Condominium. Combining spacious interiors with a prime downtown location, this home has everything you need for a sophisticated yet low-maintenance lifestyle. From the moment you step into the welcoming foyer, you'll feel at home in the thoughtfully designed layout. The open-concept living and dining areas flow seamlessly into an updated eat-in kitchen, complete with sleek stone countertops, premium appliances, and a generously sized pantry. Hardwood floors throughout the main living spaces add timeless charm, while the bedrooms are carpeted for comfort. Storage is plentiful with multiple closets, two dedicated storage units, and a full-size laundry room, ensuring all your needs are met. The unit also includes two deeded garage spaces and ample visitor parking for convenience. The Buckingham Condominium enhances your lifestyle with a wide range of amenities. Relax by the outdoor heated pool, rejuvenate in the sauna, or host friends in the community room with its full kitchen. The building also has a library and recreational features like a TV and ping pong table. With 24/7 doorman service and a gated garage, peace of mind is guaranteed. Located in the heart of downtown Stamford, this condo puts you just steps away from everything the city provides. Walk to everything.
